name: phone-field
title: Phone field
description: A phone number with a searchable calling-code picker: digits group as typed, a pasted international number picks its country, and the value is stored as E.164.

when: Any phone number a person types: sign-up, checkout, contact details.

instead.when: The value is an extension or a short code, not a full number.

keyboard.does: Opens the country list from the country button.
Searches countries by name or calling code.

builtIn: The country button is named with the country and its code.
Too short and too long say so in words.
Required fields show "Fill in this field."
youProvide: suggestedCountries for the markets the form expects.

genui.description: A phone number with a country picker. Emits change with the E.164 value and the country.
